name: Wii Startup Disc
description: A rare initialization disc used only on early pre-installed Wii consoles. It was required to complete system setup on certain launch units and was never sold at retail.

name: Wii Sports
description: A collection of motion-controlled sports games including Tennis, Bowling, Baseball, Boxing, and Golf. Bundled with most Wii consoles and widely credited for the system's global success.

name: Wii Play
description: A set of simple motion-controlled mini-games bundled with a Wii Remote, designed to teach players the basics of Wii controls.

name: Wii Fit
description: A fitness game that introduced the Wii Balance Board, offering yoga, strength training, aerobics, and balance activities.
controversy_description: Some criticism over BMI-based measurements and weight sensitivity.

name: Wii Fit Plus
description: An enhanced version of Wii Fit featuring new exercises, balance games, and customizable workout routines.
controversy_description: Same BMI-related criticisms as the original Wii Fit.

name: Wii Sports Resort
description: A sequel to Wii Sports introducing Wii MotionPlus precision controls and new activities such as Swordplay, Archery, and Air Sports.

name: New Super Mario Bros. Wii
description: A side-scrolling Mario platformer featuring four-player co-op and classic Mario gameplay with modern enhancements.
controversy_description: Some fans criticized the difficulty spikes and chaotic multiplayer.

name: Mario Kart Wii
description: A kart racing game featuring motion controls, online play, motorcycles, and the iconic Wii Wheel accessory.
controversy_description: Rubberband AI and item imbalance were common complaints.

name: Super Smash Bros. Brawl
description: A crossover fighting game featuring characters from across Nintendo franchises, introducing the Subspace Emissary story mode.
controversy_description: Competitive players criticized input lag and random tripping.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
description: An action-adventure game and Wii launch title featuring motion-controlled swordplay and a darker tone compared to previous Zelda games.
controversy_description: Some fans disliked the mirrored world layout compared to the GameCube version.
